# Third-party assets

The Vertical Slice uses Unity primitives, built-in fonts and locally generated materials.
No third-party art, asset packs or downloaded audio are included.

Original project assets generated by `DemoSceneBuilder`:

- `Wind.wav`: deterministic filtered noise, generated by `CreateWindClip`.
- `Grow.wav`, `Fall.wav`, `Sea.wav`, `Water.wav`, `Ambience.wav`: deterministic
  synthesized placeholder audio, generated by `Sound` (seeded noise + simple tones).
- `SeaSurface.shader`: original mathematical wave/foam color animation; no fluid simulation or external texture.
- Hero/background geometry and materials: generated from Unity primitives.

All above were generated locally on 2026-10-04, with no downloaded source.

When adding external assets, record each asset here before importing:
